The '''Knel'char system''',<ref name="EAOC" /> also known as the '''Darkknell system''',<ref name="TEA" /> was a [[Trinary star/Legends|trinary]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]].
